bundle.shortDescription: Free, no-code Systematic Review & Meta-Analysis desktop app (PRISMA 2020)
bundle.longDescription: poolr is a free, open-source, no-code desktop app for systematic reviews and meta-analyses — PICO builder, multi-database search strategies, dual independent screening, data extraction, risk of bias (RoB 2 / NOS / PROBAST), random-effects meta-analysis, forest & funnel plots, GRADE profiles, and PRISMA 2020 manuscript export. Runs fully offline; your data stays on your machine.
